_comment: Where each name's headline figures come from. Two providers, because no
single free and official source covers nine exchanges.
edgar - SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts. Free, keyless, and the numbers are
tagged in the company's own filing, which is as close to the
original as this gets. Covers the 13 US-listed names.
fmp   - a licensed aggregator, for the venues EDGAR has nothing for.
Needs FMP_API_KEY in the environment.
`providers` is the switch, and it is deliberately a decision recorded here
rather than a side effect of which secrets happen to be set. Only providers
listed run; a name on any other provider is skipped and says so. Right now
that is edgar alone: no key, no spend, 13 of 23 names, and the other ten
showing nothing — which is the correct behaviour rather than a gap, because
ten names showing nothing beats ten showing something wrong. To turn the
rest on, add "fmp" here and set FMP_API_KEY. The symbol mapping below is
kept intact so that is a one-line change.
cik is null until scripts/resolve-ciks.js fills it from the SEC's own
ticker map. Nobody types these by hand: a wrong CIK does not error, it
fetches a different company's accounts and puts them on the deck under the
right ticker. `expect` is the company the deck thinks the ticker is, and the
resolver checks the SEC registrant name against it before accepting a
number. A name left unresolved is skipped by the fetcher, not guessed.
